title: Ranger Resilience and Improved Performance on Phospholipid Bound Omega-3's

sections.abstract: The goal of this study is to determine if supplementation with krill oil concentrate containing the phospholipid-bound omega-3 fatty acids improves performance on specific cognitive tests that underlie key elements in U.S. Army Infantry Basic Officer Leaders Course (IBOLC) and in Ranger School (Training) at Fort Benning, Georgia (GA).
